subject: Majority Voting
source_sentence: We used majority voting to select the final perceived sarcasm label for each tweet.
title: iSarcasm: A Dataset of Intended Sarcasm

subject: Softmax
source_sentence: then adds a binary softmax layer to output a probability distribution over labels ( sarcastic or non-sarcastic )
title: iSarcasm: A Dataset of Intended Sarcasm

subject: Pre-Trained Embeddings
source_sentence: H is then concatenated with a tweet embedding S computed in advance by averaging embeddings of all words inside using the pre-trained embeddings provided by Bravo-Marquez et al.
title: iSarcasm: A Dataset of Intended Sarcasm

subject: Sentiment
source_sentence: H and S are further concatenated with a sentiment feature vector of the tweet computed in advance using the weka toolkit , by applying the TweetToLexiconFeatureVector and TweetToSentiStrengthFeatureVector filters.
title: iSarcasm: A Dataset of Intended Sarcasm
